claims: Mo is a Peabody Award-winning Netflix comedy-drama series.
Mo was created by comedian Mo Amer.
Mo is available to stream on Netflix.
Mo is a semi-autobiographical look at a Palestinian refugee's life in Texas.
Mo was not canceled due to poor performance.
It was announced in January 2023 that Mo was renewed for a second and final season.
Mo's second season premiered on January 30, 2025.
Both seasons of Mo are available to stream on Netflix.
